message.content: {"class":"TEST_CODE_DEFECT","reasoning":"The fixture-creation tie-break classifies an unchecked failed setup call as TEST_CODE_DEFECT when the test carries on against a fixture that was never created. The setup POST returned 500, but createOrder() did not check the status; the logs confirm it proceeded with orderId=null and requested /api/v1/orders/null/items, producing the 404 that failed the assertion."}
